channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: Congress criticises US arms deals with Israel, Saudi Arabia
item.description: The Trump administration has approved significant new arms sales to Israel and Saudi Arabia, totalling $6.67 billion and $9 billion respectively, prompting criticism in Congress over the timing and handling of the announcements, media reports said on Saturday.

item.title: 12 Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza
item.description: At least 12 Palestinians, including children, have been killed in Israeli airstrikes in the Gaza Strip, according to media reports.

item.title: 30,000 Afghans to perform Hajj as pilgrimage costs reduced
item.description: The Ministry of Hajj and Religious Affairs (MoHRA) announced on Saturday that 30,000 Afghans will travel to Saudi Arabia to perform Hajj this year, with the cost per pilgrim reduced by nearly 16,000 afghanis compared to last year.

item.title: Nearly 2m chick hatched in Kandahar every month
item.description: About two million chicks are being produced every month in several poultry farms in southern Kandahar, meeting 70 percent of the province’s chicken meat demand and supplying neighbouring provinces.

item.title: Militants launch ‘coordinated’ attacks across Balochistan
item.description: Separatist militants affiliated with the Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA) launched coordinated attacks across several parts of Balochistan on Saturday, according to media reports.

item.title: 1 killed, 14 injured in gas explosion in Iran’s Bandar Abbas
item.description: One child has been killed and 14 others injured in a gas explosion in the Iranian port city of Bandar Abbas, according to local media reports.

item.title: 31 Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza
item.description: At least 31 Palestinians, including six children, have been killed in Israeli bombardments across Gaza, a day before the Rafah border crossing is scheduled to reopen, media reports said

item.title: IEA names key appointments across ministers, provinces, govt offices
item.description: The Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan (IEA) has announced a number of new appointments across several ministries, government departments and provinces.

item.title: New refugee town inaugurated in Zabul for refugees
item.description: The Ministry of Refugees and Repatriation (MoRR) on Sunday announced the inauguration of the second refugee town in southern Zabul province, providing 5,000 residential plots for returning refugees.
